outcome: knowledge of caesarean section and assisted delivery
perception of caesarean section and assisted delivery
cohort: 220 women who attended the antenatal and immunisation clinics of Babcock University Teaching Hospital in southwest Nigeria.
finding: Most participants (62.7%) had good knowledge and (59.1%) good perception of caesarean section and assisted delivery, with age and marital status significantly associated with knowledge.
cross-section timing: during antenatal and immunisation clinic visits
